name: Bata
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Boyd, Raymond 2001. Bata phonology: a reappraisal. 60pp (per Glottolog langdoc for bata1314); no online copy found.

sources.citation: Gravina, Richard. 2014. The phonology of Proto-Central Chadic. LOT 375 (Bata group section pp. 144-151)
sources.note: Reconstruction explicitly excludes tone and stress ('though not including tone or stress'); Bata group treated only for segmental correspondences.

sources.citation: Boyd, Raymond. 2002. Bata phonology: a reappraisal. Munich: LINCOM Europa (Languages of the World 27). 60 pp. ISBN 3895863645. — corrected glossary (pp. 54-58) posted by the author
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: HathiTrust digitized, search-only (in copyright); interlibrary loan
sources.note: Only the glossary extract is open: a 'Notation' paragraph on vowel/consonant prosodies and ~250 tone-marked lexical items (grave/acute marks, e.g. ßàkàre 'bird', ¿úmbòto 'flour'); no sentence about stress, accent or tone placement.
Consonant and 7-vowel inventories from Boyd 2002; no mention of tone or stress.

sources.citation: Boyd, Raymond. Bata (kwā ɓwàryē), langue du groupe tchadique central — author's web page
sources.note: States only that the 2002 LINCOM book exists (LW 27) and that font-conversion errors affected some initial implosives; links the corrected glossary. Nothing on stress.
